cox.name: one binary covariate, distinct times
cox.about: the simplest model: no ties, so Efron's correction is inactive

cox.name: mixed covariates, heavy ties
cox.about: binary + unscaled age + a 3-level categorical; integer-month times put many deaths at the same time

cox.name: stratified by study
cox.about: three strata with different baseline hazards, each its own risk set (stratifyByStudy)

cox.name: small sample
cox.about: 25 patients with ties: wide intervals, where a numerical shortcut would show

cox.name: large effect
cox.about: HR around 8: a large first Newton step from beta=0, the case step-halving exists for

logistic.name: one binary covariate
logistic.about: the simplest model: a single 0/1 predictor

logistic.name: rare outcome
logistic.about: about 4% events: the baseline rate the intercept has to carry
